percentiles: Nearest rank over successful measured samples; warmups and failed attempts excluded; raw attempts retained
boundary: Synchronous core API return; excludes status lookup for preview selection, result checksums/validation, app worker queues, presentation metadata, editors, image decoding and GPUI frames
cache_conditions: One retained GitRepository/object reader; no app content cache; OS caches not flushed. Setup reads status, pins refs and reads selected changed files. Per-sample result checksums run outside timing and warm memory caches.
limits: Budget checked before samples and between pages; active core calls retain their own bounds. A full/page/scan/byte/time stop is not exhaustive history. Status equality does not detect arbitrary unchanged-status edits; inspect preview result_changed and fixture stability.
